description: Read the public CrewPay proof tape (GET /api/proof): fee-share-locked launches, creator-fee remits, and buyback runs. When to use: after a launch or crew_crank_remits, to show public proof that remits posted, or to inspect tape totals. No API key. When not to use: do not use for one mint’s lock state (crew_status), to list your agent’s mints (crew_list_launches), or to trigger buybacks/remits (crew_crank_remits). Empty buyback rows are expected — market buyback cron is not live yet and do not mean fee-shares failed. Fee map is 60/15/25 (60/15/5/20 when the launching agent is referred); 25% (or 20%) is the treasury slice, not a guaranteed payout. Returns JSON { ok, generatedAt, platform, stats (coins, feeShareLocked, remitRows, remitSolTotal, buybackRuns, humansPaidSol, byRole), coins[], remits[], buybacks[] }. Empty arrays mean no locked launches yet — not an error. Side effects: none. Read-only public GET. Does not change chain, board, or keys.

limit.description: Optional integer 1–100 (default 40). Max tape rows for coins/remits/buybacks. Example: 20.

name: crew_proof
title: Public CREW proof tape
